whats_new_v3_2: OODA Loop Integration: Full 4-step embedded — every executor node = Observe (real-time data + snapshots) → Orient (memory lattice + culture + experience + analysis) → Decide (1 hypothesis) → Act (artifact that changes env + generates feedback). Orientation most important, shapes Observe/Decide/Act quality.

Tempo Over Speed: Timing regulation not raw speed wins. Regulate speed to coincide with env weakness. Science lens: decisions=hypotheses, actions=tests. Late commitment agility vs PDCA early commitment. Speed vs Perfection: move at 70% + course-correct beats waiting.

9 Production-Grade Best Practices (arXiv): tool-first over MCP, pure-function invocation, single-tool single-responsibility agents, externalized prompts, Responsible-AI consortium, clean separation workflow vs MCP, containerized scale, KISS 3-7 nodes max, deterministic orchestration.

6 Orchestration Guarantees: Structured Execution (DAG/state machine/behavior tree/event), Tool Safety (schema validation + sandbox), Memory Mgmt (read/update discipline + summaries + long/episodic), Reasoning Boundaries (max-step 7 + deterministic loops + controlled context), Evaluation Hooks (correctness/reliability/coherence/tool failures/hallucination/comms/quality), Multi-Agent Orchestration (routing + message passing + shared memory + hierarchical control + role enforcement + concurrency 4).

Two Loop Types: Linear for step-by-step analysis/context extraction, Circular streaming for live enrich where background agents enrich real-time via comm layer — never direct agent→agent calls, route via orchestrator.
3-Layer Separation: Execution (agents/responders), Communication (queues/events/RPC), Orchestration (DAG + replans + eval). Prevents infinite loops, memory chaos, drift, malformed inputs.

Planner DAG v3.2 upgraded: 3-8 nodes epic, single-responsibility, pure-function, externalized prompts, KISS. Optimistic vs Pessimistic diverge on risk but merge keeps verification. Parallel heuristic max 4 concurrent safe.
